name: cagents
description: Universal multi-domain agent orchestration framework. 60 agents across 9 builder-role archetypes (developer/operator/advisor/analyst/creator/writer/strategist/core/leadership), coordinated by an intelligent pipeline. 4 user skills: /act routes any task through controller + specialist agents (review/audit/optimize/improve modes via keyword router), /team runs parallel agent waves with Strategic Mode for cross-domain work, /designer guides design exploration, /helper guides usage.
